📋 برومبت Google Flow — جاهز للنسخ

Photorealistic live-action Algerian short film. 10 seconds exactly — Horizontal landscape 16:9.

Animate the scene from the attached images, keeping the two men's faces, outfits and the workshop environment EXACTLY as shown: the older man (around 60, gray-white hair, thin gray mustache, dark-green jacket over white shirt) is the Haj; the young man (mid-twenties, dark navy-blue mechanic coverall, red cloth in his back pocket) is Amine. Warm golden late-afternoon light inside the modest auto repair workshop, car on the lift in the background.

0–4s — Wide shot from the first attached image. The Haj walks ahead coming out of the small office door, Amine follows, gently stops him with a hand on his arm and says in Algerian dialect (lip-synced, worried but respectful young male voice):
«يا الحاج، تعالى معايا شويّة… نوريك شي حاجة قبل ما تحكم.»

4–6s — Medium two-shot as in the second attached image. The Haj turns to face Amine with a serious heavy face and replies in a low older male voice (lip-synced):
«ورّيني.»

6–10s — The two men walk together toward a narrow side corridor entrance on the left, camera tracks laterally with them at a calm pace. Final frame: both men seen from behind at the corridor entrance, the corridor visible ahead.

CAMERA: static wide opening, then one smooth short lateral tracking move. No fast movements, no zooms.
SOUND: quiet workshop ambience, distant street sounds, footsteps on concrete, faint metal clink. No music.
FORMAT: Horizontal landscape 16:9 only, cinematic widescreen framing. Never vertical 9:16, never portrait, never square. Do not crop the image into a vertical frame.

🚫 Negative Prompt

إن وُجد في Flow حقل Negative منفصل — الصقه هناك؛ وإلا فهو مدمج في البرومبت أعلاه

No vertical 9:16, no portrait, no square. Do not change faces, ages, hairstyles or outfits from the attached images. No extra characters, no customer visible. No distorted hands, no extra fingers, no fused hands, no floating objects. Do not move the desk, money box or security monitor. No text, no watermark, no subtitles, no logos. Only Amine speaks during 0–4s and only the Haj speaks during 4–6s — the listener's lips must not move.
